message:
I have a dear friend who tends to panic at the slightest hint of trouble. Just the other day, she called me in a flurry because she heard a storm was coming. I listened to her worries and then reminded her of the little go-bag I keep by the door — just some snacks, a flashlight, and essentials. 

It’s funny how we sometimes overlook the simple things that can bring peace of mind. I assured her that having a plan in place can make all the difference, and we ended up laughing about how preparing can be a lot less stressful than panicking. 

Have you ever found yourself in a similar situation?
